funding_types.quote: The program offers repayable loans of up to $20,000 for newcomers to start a new business or purchase an existing business in Newfoundland and Labrador.

max_amount.quote: The program offers repayable loans of up to $20,000 for newcomers to start a new business or purchase an existing business in Newfoundland and Labrador.

criteria.text: A newcomer who can't get other support because of residency status (the page says non-permanent residents)
criteria.quote: The Newcomer Loan Program is designed to provide financing to newcomers who are ineligible to receive support because of their residency status.

criteria.text: Your residency status at the time of application fits the page's rule
criteria.quote: Non-permanent residents or citizens of Canada at the time of application.

criteria.text: Your local CBDC offers this loan (programs vary by region)
criteria.quote: Programs and services delivered by CBDCs may vary by region.

research.notes: For non-permanent residents; our profile's "newcomer" answer means arrived in the last five years, which is a different definition, so ownership is not a rule (API §4) and residency is check-this-yourself. The page's criterion reads "Non-permanent residents or citizens of Canada at the time of application", which is ambiguous as written; it is quoted as is, with the program description as a second check-this-yourself item. "19 and older" is about the applicant, not the business. Financial support is from the Government of Newfoundland and Labrador. Intake: not stated. Contacts: the offices of CBDC Central (Grand Falls-Windsor), CBDC Gander Area and CBDC Emerald (Baie Verte, with a Springdale satellite office), each quoted from its own cbdc.ca office page saved as a source of this record; all three pages list this loan. Only the Gander Area page names the places it serves (a list of place names, not census divisions), so census_divisions is null for every office and there is no location rule beyond the province (contract question B). Other CBDCs in the province are not listed as contacts.
